requiredFutureEvidence: Fresh successful actual deployment operation and approved immutable candidate/parameter/LOCAL-09 hashes.
Exact actual RG/storage/NSP/profile/association IDs and empty owned account inventory.
Storage ARM properties: SecuredByPerimeter, HTTPS true, anonymous/shared-key false, TLS1_2, Hot/non-HNS and deny/None fallback.
NSP GET: provisioningState Succeeded and actual perimeterGuid.
Profile GET: exact ID and nonmissing accessRulesVersion. The pinned profile API has no provisioningState field; do not invent it.
Association GET: exact target storage/profile IDs, Enforced, provisioningState Succeeded, hasProvisioningIssues no.
Complete profile accessRules list with zero items and no unconsumed nextLink.

Complete storage networkSecurityPerimeterConfigurations list/get: one matching effective configuration, Succeeded, empty provisioningIssues, matching NSP ID/perimeterGuid, matching association name/Enforced mode, matching profile name/accessRulesVersion and zero effective accessRules.
failureSemantics: Missing fields, partial inventories, failed reads, stale versions, provisioning issues or wrong bindings mean incomplete/unknown, never passed. SecuredByPerimeter alone is insufficient.
noRulesMeaning: Enforced zero-rule configuration intent, not an executed data-plane blocking test. No data access is performed.
limits: No full access-control or RTO/RPO assurance
